address: Goodwood Park Hotel, 22 Scotts Road, 228221, Singapore
bio: With an executive chef on board since 2023, Alma now offers two tasting menus at lunch and dinner, featuring well-crafted European dishes strewn with Asian accents. The menus change every three months to keep pace with premium seasonal produce. The venison course is especially impressive depicted by spot-on cooking, juicy meat, fine texture and robust flavour. Whisky lovers should check out the cellar rich in rarities....
